description: This Java source file implements an Android activity named CompressedTextureActivity that demonstrates using ETC1 compressed textures with OpenGL ES. It includes methods for loading textures from resources and creating textures on the fly, with support for compressed texture formats and resource management.

classes.name: CompressedTextureActivity
classes.description: Main activity class demonstrating ETC1 compressed textures in OpenGL ES on Android.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the GLSurfaceView and its renderer based on configuration flags.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses the GLSurfaceView rendering when activity is paused.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes the GLSurfaceView rendering when activity is resumed.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a compressed texture either from resources or creates it on the fly, depending on configuration.
